zh.title: 越捷航空調整11至12月國際航班　多條臺灣航線暫時減班
zh.summary: 越捷航空調整2026年冬季初期國際班表，多條臺灣航線於10月底至12月上旬暫時減班，部分河內航線仍保留12月10日起增至每週14班的規劃。
body: 越南低成本航空公司越捷航空（VietJet Air）近期調整2026年北半球冬季班表，多條國際航線於10月底至12月上旬期間縮減班次，其中臺灣市場涵蓋河內往返高雄、臺中，以及胡志明市往返高雄、臺中與桃園等航線。航空班表資料顯示，此次減班多屬特定期間調整，部分航線目前仍維持12月10日後原先規劃的增班安排。
河內內排國際機場（HAN）－高雄國際機場（KHH）航線自10月27日至12月9日期間，將由原訂每週10班縮減至每週5班，12月4日起先回升至每週7班。目前12月10日起增加至每週14班、相當於每日2班的規劃並未更動。
河內－臺中國際機場（RMQ）航線則自10月25日至12月9日期間由每週11班縮減至每週7班，其中11月6日起進一步減至每週5班，12月6日起恢復每週7班。與高雄航線相同，目前系統仍保留12月10日起增加至每週14班的原定計畫。
胡志明市新山一國際機場（SGN）出發的臺灣航線亦有調整。胡志明市－高雄航線預計於10月25日至12月7日期間，由每日1班、每週7班縮減至每週4班；胡志明市－臺中則於10月25日至12月6日期間，同樣由每週7班降至每週4班。
此外，胡志明市－桃園國際機場（TPE）航線亦出現階段性減班安排，10月25日至12月4日期間由原規劃每週7班縮減至每週4班。這項異動未列入AeroRoutes於10月2日公布的越捷航空11月至12月區域航線減班清單，因此需與其他已列出的臺灣航線分開看待；現階段部分第三方班表資料仍可能顯示較早載入的每日班表，實際營運應以航空公司訂位系統最新可售日期為準。
此次調整並不限於臺灣市場。AeroRoutes資料顯示，越捷航空同期也縮減峴港－首爾仁川、河內－新加坡、河內－首爾仁川、胡志明市－香港、胡志明市－釜山及富國島－首爾仁川等多條亞洲區域航線，顯示此次屬於較大範圍的冬季初期運能調整。
越捷航空在2026年9月及10月期間亦曾對部分航班進行調整，而AeroRoutes指出，這些較早期的異動並未逐一納入其報導。至於12月10日之後目前仍維持的班表，包括河內－高雄與河內－臺中增至每週14班等規劃，後續是否再次調整，仍須視航空公司更新訂位系統與實際運能安排而定。

en.title: VietJet Adjusts November–December International Schedule, Temporarily Cuts Several Taiwan Routes
en.summary: VietJet Air has reduced frequencies on several Taiwan routes for parts of late October through early December 2026, while some planned increases from December 10 remain in place.
body: Vietnamese low-cost carrier VietJet Air has adjusted its 2026 Northern Hemisphere winter schedule, reducing frequencies on a number of international routes from late October through early December. In the Taiwan market, the changes affect Hanoi services to Kaohsiung and Taichung, as well as Ho Chi Minh City services to Kaohsiung, Taichung and Taoyuan. Timetable data indicates that most of the reductions are limited to specific periods, while some previously planned increases after December 10 remain unchanged for now.

On the Hanoi Noi Bai International Airport (HAN)–Kaohsiung International Airport (KHH) route, service is set to fall from the originally planned 10 weekly flights to five per week between October 27 and December 9, before increasing to seven weekly flights from December 4. The current plan to raise frequencies to 14 flights per week, equivalent to twice daily, from December 10 remains unchanged.

The Hanoi–Taichung International Airport (RMQ) route is scheduled to drop from 11 weekly flights to seven between October 25 and December 9, with a further reduction to five weekly flights from November 6 before returning to seven per week from December 6. As with the Kaohsiung route, the system currently still shows the previously planned increase to 14 weekly flights from December 10.

Taiwan routes from Ho Chi Minh City's Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN) are also being adjusted. Ho Chi Minh City–Kaohsiung is expected to decrease from daily service, or seven flights per week, to four weekly flights between October 25 and December 7. Ho Chi Minh City–Taichung will likewise be reduced from seven to four weekly flights between October 25 and December 6.

The Ho Chi Minh City–Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) route also shows a temporary reduction, falling from the previously planned seven weekly flights to four per week between October 25 and December 4. This change was not included in AeroRoutes' October 2 list of VietJet regional frequency reductions for November and December, so it should be considered separately from the Taiwan routes listed there. Some third-party timetable databases may still display an earlier daily schedule, and actual operations should be checked against the airline's latest bookable inventory.

The adjustments are not limited to the Taiwan market. AeroRoutes data shows that VietJet is also reducing frequencies during the same period on several regional Asian routes, including Da Nang–Seoul Incheon, Hanoi–Singapore, Hanoi–Seoul Incheon, Ho Chi Minh City–Hong Kong, Ho Chi Minh City–Busan and Phu Quoc–Seoul Incheon, indicating a broader capacity adjustment for the early winter season.

VietJet had also adjusted some flights during September and October 2026, and AeroRoutes noted that those earlier changes were not individually included in its report. For schedules after December 10 that currently remain in place, including planned increases to 14 weekly flights on Hanoi–Kaohsiung and Hanoi–Taichung, further changes remain possible depending on future booking-system updates and the airline's actual capacity plans.
